name: Central New Energy Holding Group Limited
summary: Central New Energy Holding Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the business of foundation, superstructure building, and other construction works in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. It operates through New Energy and EPC; Green building and construction related business; Smart energy management services; Health and wellness; and F&B supply chain. The New Energy and EPC segment is involved in the manufacturing and sales of photovoltaic products and EPC.
